children: RNS Number : 0940V  Portmeirion Group PLC  17 September 2026
Portmeirion Group PLC, the global homewares brand group, will announce its results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 on Wednesday 23 September 2026.

A link to watch a recording of the management team talking through the investor presentation will be provided in the results announcement on the day. The Group will be hosting a webinar with Q&A for investors through the BRR Media Engage Investor platform after the results, details of which will be provided in due course.
Kate Hoare / Charlie Barker / Polly Clarke
Shore Capital (Nominated Adviser and Joint Broker)
Patrick Castle / Lucy Bowden – Corporate Advisory
Malachy McEntyre / Isobel Jones – Corporate Broking

Portmeirion Group PLC is a global homewares brand group based in Stoke-on-Trent, England.  The Group owns six unrivalled heritage and contemporary brands; Spode, Portmeirion, Royal Worcester, Pimpernel, Wax Lyrical and Nambé.   The Group serves markets across the world, with global demand driven by diversified international markets including the key geographies of North America, the UK and South Korea.
